text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Mmh? What is that over there...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Trai-chan, Trai-chan. Looks like a prime 
data collection opportunity has arrived.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Looking at her form and all that dirt... 
Teio-chan is pushing herself reaaally 
hard, I think.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume pushing past her own limits 
is practically a treasure trove of data, 
don't you think?!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"If we ask for a tandem run, we can 
observe without looking suspicious, 
right?"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Right? It's totally worth a shot.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Right? It's totally worth a shot.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huh!? You'll run with me? Yay!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Mind if I suggest the menu for our tandem 
run?"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
This is a brand-new menu that was just 
proposed. I've actually been wanting to 
give it a try.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I especially recommend it to anyone who 
really wants to hone themselves~
choice_data_list:
...I see. It's nice that it puts less 
strain on the body.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Oooh! That's totally perfect for me right 
now! I'll get even closer to the Prez this 
way!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'm heading to the track first! 
Get ready and meet me there~!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
? Whatcha looking at, Trainey? Staring so 
hard and all.
choice_data_list:
So it was to keep Teio from pushing 
herself too hard, huh.

So it was to keep Teio from pushing 
herself too hard, huh.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Just because she asked to run 
together? No way~ You're overthinking it.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Well, I kinda figured if it was only 
benefits for us, it wouldn't match up with 
the reward, you kno~w?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Hmm, well, that's true.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'm just gonna go say hi real quick. 
It won't take long, so you go on ahead 
without me~.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Huh! Wow! Is this the latest training 
method?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yep, yep. It puts less strain on the body, 
making it perfect for pushing through 
training.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I'd love to try it! But... Any more than 
this and I'd be overworking myself.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
! Nishishi, so the reward is "results", 
huh? Roger that!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Well then, guess I'll make a quick trip 
home.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...With that routine having plenty of 
breaks, we shouldn't need to worry.
